item.title: Mandelbrots on the BBC Micro
item.description: At the end of the last fractal post I joked about leaving the BBC Micro on overnight for a single picture. So this time I went back to where it started for me: BBC BASIC in MODE 2. I had Claude drive the MacBeeb emulator and type the programs in at the > prompt, with the emulator window open so I could watch it go, one key at a time, the way I used to copy listings out of magazines.

item.title: Retro Fractal Zoom
item.description:
This one tickled my 8 bit brain.

I remember having to leave my BBC Micro on overnight to calculate a single low res image of a Mandelbrot fractal. Now, with a couple of prompts and a bit of to and fro with the Claude app on my phone, it renders a whole retro styled zoom video like this in a couple of minutes.

Retro fractal zoom on Flickr
